panels.description: Most recent assigned-seat count per connected organization within the selected range, summed across organizations. Uses one row per (connection, scope) via the latest date in range, so multi-org totals are additive, not duplicated.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_summary AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_summaries s
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT connection_id, scope_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_summaries
    WHERE $__timeFilter(STR_TO_DATE(date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
    GROUP BY connection_id, scope_id
  ) latest
    ON latest.connection_id = s.connection_id
   AND latest.scope_id = s.scope_id
   AND latest.max_date = s.date
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(assigned_seats), 0) AS "Assigned Seats"
FROM latest_summary

panels.description: Distinct active users and total sessions per supported product, from ai_activities (provider=claude_enterprise). Only Claude Code and Claude chat appear here because Phase 9 only converts those two products into ai_activities; other Enterprise products (e.g. Cowork) remain tool-only until their domain mapping is confirmed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE type
    WHEN 'CODE_EDIT' THEN 'Claude Code'
    WHEN 'CHAT' THEN 'Claude Chat'
    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(type, ''), 'Unknown')
  END AS "Product",
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(user_email, '')) AS "Active Users",
  SUM(num_sessions) AS "Sessions"
FROM ai_activities
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND provider = 'claude_enterprise'
GROUP BY type
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(user_email, '')) DESC

panels.description: Daily input+output tokens grouped by product, from _tool_claude_enterprise_usage_reports. Grouping by product before summing avoids multiplying totals across the model dimension.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(starting_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ') AS time,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(product, ''), 'Unknown') AS metric,
  SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS value
FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_usage_reports
WHERE $__timeFilter(STR_TO_DATE(starting_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ'))
GROUP BY STR_TO_DATE(starting_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ'), COALESCE(NULLIF(product, ''), 'Unknown')
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Token Use by Product Over Time

panels.description: Token usage broken down by product and model, from _tool_claude_enterprise_usage_reports. Each row is grouped at the table's native (product, model) grain, so totals are not duplicated across models.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(product, ''), 'Unknown') AS "Product",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(model, ''), 'Unknown') AS "Model",
  SUM(input_tokens) AS "Input Tokens",
  SUM(output_tokens) AS "Output Tokens",
  SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS "Cache Read Tokens",
  SUM(cache_creation_tokens) AS "Cache Creation Tokens",
  SUM(request_count) AS "Requests"
FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_usage_reports
WHERE $__timeFilter(STR_TO_DATE(starting_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ'))
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(product, ''), 'Unknown'), COALESCE(NULLIF(model, ''), 'Unknown')
ORDER BY SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens) DESC

panels.description: Users ranked by Claude Code + chat session volume in the selected range, from ai_activities (provider=claude_enterprise). Deleted users or rows with a blank email are grouped under "Unknown User" instead of being silently dropped or merged into another account.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), 'Unknown User') AS "User",
  COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "Active Days",
  SUM(num_sessions) AS "Sessions",
  SUM(lines_added) AS "Lines Added",
  SUM(commits_created) AS "Commits",
  SUM(prs_created) AS "PRs"
FROM ai_activities
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  AND provider = 'claude_enterprise'
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), 'Unknown User')
ORDER BY SUM(num_sessions) DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.description: Users ranked by USD cost in the selected range, from _tool_claude_enterprise_cost_reports. Deleted users or rows with a blank email fall back to the upstream user ID, or "Unknown User" if neither is present, instead of being silently merged into the first matching account.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), CONCAT('User ', NULLIF(user_id, '')), 'Unknown User') AS "User",
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(20,4))), 2) AS "Cost (USD)"
FROM _tool_claude_enterprise_cost_reports
WHERE $__timeFilter(STR_TO_DATE(starting_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ'))
  AND UPPER(currency) = 'USD'
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), CONCAT('User ', NULLIF(user_id, '')), 'Unknown User')
ORDER BY SUM(CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(20,4))) DESC
LIMIT 25
